ModMetaData.name: Abyssal Protocol
ModMetaData.author: Neversalimus
ModMetaData.description:
Abyssal Protocol is a techno-infernal RimWorld 1.6 endgame expansion about controlled summoning, forbidden infrastructure and boss-driven progression. Colonies do not merely fight a stronger faction: they build the machinery that invites the Abyss, bind its answers into repeatable rites, and turn survived breaches into weapons, implants, sigils and deeper access.
Build the Abyssal Summoning Circle and Abyssal Forge, gather residue and sigils, trigger hostile ritual encounters, survive abyssal elites and bosses, and convert what remains into stronger equipment and darker forms of permission.
Includes custom summoning and forge systems, abyssal consoles, residue and sigil progression, Sigil Vault support, circle modules, instability, hostile manifestations, multiple abyssal enemies, miniboss and boss content, custom weapons and implants, VFX/audio work, and EN/RU localization.
